description: Figma variable collections generated from library/tokens/src. Import with library/tokens/figma-import.js (tokens.py figma-script prints a ready-to-run use_figma script). COLOR values are 0-1 RGBA, FLOAT values are px (rem x 16), TIMING values are seconds. An alias value names a variable by collection and slash path.

collections.name: Primitives
collections.description: Raw ramps and scales. Modes are brands: set the Primitives mode on a frame to switch brand.

variables.name: color/white
variables.description: Pure white. Light surfaces and text on accent fills.

variables.name: color/black
variables.description: Pure black. Reserved for shadows and scrims; never a dark-mode canvas.

variables.name: font/stack/schibsted-grotesk
variables.description: Schibsted Grotesk (OFL; Bakken & Baeck for Schibsted). Sturdy news grotesk with tight apertures; Meridian display.

variables.name: font/stack/source-sans-3
variables.description: Source Sans 3 (OFL; Paul D. Hunt, Adobe). Humanist sans with wide language coverage; Meridian body.

variables.name: font/stack/jetbrains-mono
variables.description: JetBrains Mono (OFL). Tall x-height code face; Meridian mono.

variables.name: font/stack/fraunces
variables.description: Fraunces (OFL; Undercase Type). Soft variable serif with optical size and SOFT/WONK axes; Ember display.

variables.name: font/stack/figtree
variables.description: Figtree (OFL; Erik Kennedy). Friendly geometric sans with open forms; Ember body.

variables.name: font/stack/ibm-plex-mono
variables.description: IBM Plex Mono (OFL; Mike Abbink, Bold Monday). Slab-influenced mono; Ember mono.

variables.name: font/size/xs
variables.description: 12px. Badges, legal, axis labels; never body copy.

variables.name: font/size/md
variables.description: 16px. Body text and inputs (16px stops iOS zoom on focus).

variables.name: ease/standard
variables.description: Default for elements moving within the screen.

variables.name: ease/emphasized-decelerate
variables.description: Hero entrances and large surfaces arriving.

collections.name: Semantic
collections.description: Roles that change per theme. Modes are themes; values alias Primitives.

variables.name: color/bg/surface
variables.description: Default container: cards, panels, table rows, inputs.

variables.name: color/bg/surface-raised
variables.description: Floating layers: menus, popovers, dialogs, toasts. In dark mode it is lighter than surface (elevation reads as lightness).

variables.name: color/bg/sunken
variables.description: Recessed wells: code blocks, table headers, disabled inputs, progress tracks.

variables.name: color/fg/default
variables.description: Body text, headings, icons with meaning.

variables.name: color/fg/muted
variables.description: Secondary text: captions, metadata, helper text. Still 4.5:1 (7:1 in high contrast).

variables.name: color/fg/subtle
variables.description: Placeholders and non-essential text only (3:1). Never for information the user needs.

variables.name: color/fg/on-accent
variables.description: Text and icons on accent-default, accent-hover and accent-active fills.

variables.name: color/border/subtle
variables.description: Decorative dividers and card outlines (no contrast requirement).

variables.name: color/border/default
variables.description: Component borders where the border is not the only cue.

variables.name: color/border/strong
variables.description: Borders that identify a control (inputs, checkboxes, radio rings): 3:1 on canvas, WCAG 1.4.11.

variables.name: color/accent/default
variables.description: Primary action fill, selected and checked states, brand moments. Scarce: one primary per view.

variables.name: color/accent/subtle
variables.description: Tinted background: selected rows, accent badges, highlighted callouts.

variables.name: color/accent/fg
variables.description: Accent text and icons: links, active navigation. 4.5:1 on canvas, surface and accent-subtle.

variables.name: color/success/fg
variables.description: Success text and icons; 4.5:1 on Success-bg, canvas and surface.

variables.name: color/success/border
variables.description: Success boundary for alerts, badges and invalid inputs; 3:1 or more on canvas and surface (WCAG 1.4.11).

variables.name: color/warning/fg
variables.description: Warning text and icons; 4.5:1 on Warning-bg, canvas and surface.

variables.name: color/warning/border
variables.description: Warning boundary for alerts, badges and invalid inputs; 3:1 or more on canvas and surface (WCAG 1.4.11).

variables.name: color/danger/fg
variables.description: Danger text and icons; 4.5:1 on Danger-bg, canvas and surface.

variables.name: color/danger/border
variables.description: Danger boundary for alerts, badges and invalid inputs; 3:1 or more on canvas and surface (WCAG 1.4.11).

variables.name: color/info/fg
variables.description: Info text and icons; 4.5:1 on Info-bg, canvas and surface.

variables.name: color/info/border
variables.description: Info boundary for alerts, badges and invalid inputs; 3:1 or more on canvas and surface (WCAG 1.4.11).

variables.name: color/focus-ring
variables.description: Focus outline (2px, offset 2px): 3:1 against canvas, surface and raised surfaces.

notExported.line-height: unitless multipliers; Figma binds line height in px or sets percent on text styles. Use 110/125/150/165%.
notExported.letter-spacing: em values; set them as percent on Figma text styles (-2%, 0%, 1%, 6%).
notExported.measure: ch units have no Figma equivalent.
notExported.gutter: clamp() is CSS-only; use 16-32px layout grid gutters.
notExported.z: stacking order has no Figma variable.
notExported.breakpoint: media-query values; used for frame widths only.
notExported.shadow: composite values; build Figma effect styles from tokens.resolved.json (values differ per mode).
notExported.elevation: raw shadow sets behind shadow.*; same as above.
